description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by GC: "yes"). Successor to fz-9x7.30 (#719).

A minor sizes its to-space from the previous minor's copy (last_minor_copied_bytes, after #719). When the previous minor copied far more than this one can, the difference sits idle. Worst case: distiller event 788 in #719's measurement, a 3,564,448 B guess for 399,216 B copied, 3.16 MB unused. Data: GC session scratchpad 30/r2/pk.distiller.new.jsonl; the gc event carries to_space_guess_bytes and to_space_capacity_bytes. Related: fz-9x7.15 and .23 size the young generation itself, not this guess.

Experiment first, with a paper-first page (pre-registered predictions and rule) before any builder. Memory judged in in-use bytes.
title: A minor's to-space guess does not exceed what it can copy
